headline: Khaitan acts on HFCL ₹550 cr QIP
sum: HFCL raised ₹550 cr via QIP earlier in the year - Khaitan advised the issuer.
detail: Himachal Futuristic Communications Limited made a Qualified Institutional Placement aggregating to ₹550 crore. Khaitan & Co advised HFCL. HFCL designs and manufactures telecom equipment and fibre-optic cables.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “Himachal Futuristic Communications Limited has made a Qualified Institutional Placement aggregating to ₹550 crore.” - confirms Khaitan and the Kohli/Mittal team.
